dedupe_keys.name: niger enquete sur le cadre multi niveaux mtf

description: Niger - Enquête sur le cadre multi-niveaux (MTF) is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Extractive industries", published or maintained by Marina Brutinel (World Bank Group). L'enquête MTF est une enquête globale qui établit la situation de référence en matière d'accès à l'énergie et à la cuisson propre en dépassant l'approche binaire pour envisager l'accès comme un spectre de niveaux de services dont bénéficient les ménages. Des ressources additionnelles sont disponibles avec la version anglaise du rapport (données, questionnaires, stratégie d'échantillonnage). Coverage: Niger. It has 1 file in PDF. The portal files it under Extractive industries. The portal gives 2020 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
